strings.name: Sara Blakely
strings.role: Founder of Spanx and Sneex; philanthropy advocate
strings.summary: Sara Blakely moved from selling fax machines into apparel entrepreneurship, founding Spanx with $5,000 in savings and developing shapewear around clothing needs. In 2021 she brought in a majority investment from Blackstone-managed funds, launched footwear brand Sneex in 2024 and supports women through her foundation.
strings.coverageNote: Checked through November 17, 2026. Distinguishes a majority-stake closing from a total sale, company valuation from personal income, charitable pledges from payments, and honorary from earned degrees.
strings.influence.rationale: She founded Spanx around women’s consumer needs and supports women’s entrepreneurship and business education.
strings.facts.f1.label: Education
strings.facts.f1.value: Communications bachelor’s degree from Florida State University in 1993; the university’s 2026 Doctor of Humane Letters was an honorary degree.
strings.facts.f2.label: Invention and recognition
strings.facts.f2.value: Her footless shaping pantyhose design was recognized by the National Inventors Hall of Fame, whose inductee record lists U.S. patent 6,276,176.
strings.highlights.h1.title: From consumer needs to products
strings.highlights.h1.text: She developed Spanx from her own clothing experience and later explored designs combining high heels and sneakers through Sneex.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Supporting women’s development
strings.highlights.h2.text: Through the Red Backpack Foundation she supports women’s entrepreneurship and education, and made a charitable commitment by joining the Giving Pledge.
strings.timeline.t1.title: Report following Hall of Fame induction
strings.timeline.t1.text: People reported her attendance at the National Inventors Hall of Fame gala; the institution confirms her 2026 induction. This is the report’s publication date.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Honorary doctorate and commencement speech
strings.timeline.t2.text: She returned to Florida State University to accept an honorary Doctor of Humane Letters and share her entrepreneurial experience with graduates.
strings.timeline.t3.title: Launching footwear brand Sneex
strings.timeline.t3.text: She entered footwear with a design combining high heels and sneakers; comfort is a stated brand design aim.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Spanx majority transaction completed
strings.timeline.t4.text: Blackstone-managed funds completed their investment at a $1.2 billion company valuation; she was executive chairwoman at closing.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Giving Pledge announces her participation
strings.timeline.t5.text: She pledged at least half her wealth to charity; this does not mean the corresponding donations had already been made.
strings.timeline.t6.title: Establishing a charitable foundation
strings.timeline.t6.text: She founded the organization now called the Red Backpack Foundation to support women’s development.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Founding Spanx
strings.timeline.t7.text: She began with $5,000 of personal savings, developing a shapewear idea into a consumer brand.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Earning a communications bachelor’s degree
strings.timeline.t8.text: She graduated from Florida State University and later worked in fax-machine sales.
